secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://yourproject.supabase.co). Optional — the frontend works without it but auth routes will show a login prompt.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon public key. Optional — needed for auth functionality (login, session, organization context).
